newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa DP welcomes suggestion it might join govt.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa DP welcomes suggestion it might join govt.

text.p: South Africa's minority Democratic Party said on Wednesday it welcomed a suggestion from President Nelson Mandela that it might participate in the government.
"The party's federal executive adopted a positive approach to President Mandela's suggestion that the DP could play a part in the government of national unity," a statement said.
"We will seek the earliest opportunity to discuss with President Mandela the terms under which we could participate in government without in any way compromising our fundamental principles."

Analysts have suggested that Mandela is considering a larger role for minority parties, including the DP and the Pan Africanist Congress (PAC), to avoid a potential colour divide in South African politics.

Mandela appears concerned that an emerging agreement between his ruling African National Congress (ANC) and the PAC could create a situation in which the opposition parties -- the DP and the National Party -- were essentially white, while the governing parties -- the ANC, PAC and Inkatha Freedom Party -- were black, they said.
